resource.name: aws_iam_group_policy_attachment
resource.description: Attaches a Managed IAM Policy to an IAM group The usage of this resource conflicts with the aws_iam_policy_attachment resource and will permanently show a difference if both are defined.
resource.llm_summary: The `aws_iam_group_policy_attachment` resource enables the association of managed IAM policies with IAM groups, simplifying access control and permission management for multiple users. Common use cases include centralizing policy assignments for teams, enforcing consistent permissions across user groups, and streamlining role-based access control in AWS environments. This resource is ideal for configuring group-level permissions but should not be used alongside `aws_iam_policy_attachment` to avoid conflicts and persistent state differences.

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.llm_summary: This example demonstrates how to attach an IAM policy to an IAM group using the `aws_iam_group_policy_attachment` resource. It showcases the configuration of an IAM group, the creation of a custom IAM policy, and the use of the `group` and `policy_arn` arguments to establish the attachment, enabling users to manage group-level permissions effectively.

arguments.name: group
arguments.description: (Required) - The group the policy should be applied to
arguments.llm_summary: The `group` argument in the `aws_iam_group_policy_attachment` resource specifies the name of the IAM group to which the policy will be attached. By defining this argument, users can control which group of IAM users inherits the permissions defined in the attached policy, enabling centralized management of access control for multiple users.

arguments.name: id
arguments.llm_summary: The `id` argument for the `aws_iam_group_policy_attachment` resource represents the unique identifier of the attachment, typically auto-generated by Terraform. While optional, it can be used to reference or track the specific attachment instance, aiding in resource management and troubleshooting within IAM configurations.

arguments.name: policy_arn
arguments.description: (Required) - The ARN of the policy you want to apply
arguments.llm_summary: The `policy_arn` argument specifies the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM policy to be attached to the specified IAM group, enabling users to define and enforce access permissions for all members of the group. By setting this required argument, users can control the permissions and access policies applied to the group, aligning with security and compliance requirements.
